name: Alibaba Cloud OSS
summary: List, fetch and publish objects in Alibaba Cloud Object Storage Service, through its S3-compatible API or the native OSS API.

fields.name: security_token
fields.label: STS security token
fields.help: Only for temporary credentials from STS.

settings.name: internal
settings.label: Use the internal endpoint
settings.help: oss-<region>-internal.aliyuncs.com, only from Alibaba Cloud networks.

egress.note: Mainland regions may need a filed domain for custom endpoints; the default aliyuncs.com endpoints do not.

operators.summary: List objects under a prefix as a manifest.
Fetch objects into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, resumable by range.
Publish artifacts under an object prefix with multipart upload and a recorded digest.

notes: Staging bucket for MaxCompute, Hologres and AnalyticDB loads (see those connectors).
